$meta.note: Source catalogue. Every other locale is a translation of THIS file; run `npm run i18n:report` after editing to see which locales fell behind.

gate.title: Fate's Edge
gate.subtitle: The door is shut. Say the word and it opens.

lock.title: Screen locked
lock.subtitle: Nothing has been lost. The table is exactly where you left it.
lock.resetHint: Enter the emergency reset code. Whoever set this instance up has it.

shortcuts.title: ⌨️ Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.escape: Close the open dialog or panel
shortcuts.xcard: Raise or resume the X-Card (safety pause), from anywhere
shortcuts.nextCombatant: Advance to the next combatant, while the combat timer is open
shortcuts.resetTimer: Reset the combat timer, while the combat timer is open
shortcuts.undo: Undo the last whiteboard action, while the Whiteboard tab is open
shortcuts.redo: Redo, while the Whiteboard tab is open
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts marked "while ... is open" only apply when that panel is focused or visible, so they don't clash with typing elsewhere.

xcard.message: X‑Card has been called. Pause the scene and check in with your group.
xcard.explainer: The X‑Card is a safety tool: any player can call it at any time to stop a scene that is making them uncomfortable. No questions asked.

language.heading: 🌐 Language
language.intro: Choose the language the toolkit's interface is shown in. Game content — adventures, wiki entries, patrons and other data — stays in the language it was written in. Anything not yet translated falls back to English, so nothing goes missing.
language.autoNoteUnsupported: (matching your browser — it asked for a language we do not ship yet, so English it is)
language.coverageTitle: Untranslated text falls back to English
language.contribute: Adding a language takes one JSON file — see TRANSLATION.md in the web client.
